description: BUG 1 (mgmt backend): new-contribution push notification shows the raw USER#### id code instead of the person's display name. In mgmt/backend/src/push.js, notifyNewContribution builds the body from `const name = (payload && (payload.Name ?? '')).toString().trim();` but payload.Name is the COLLECTIONS row's 'Name' field, which stores a USER#### id CODE (see tableRegistry.js), not a display name. Resolve the id code to the person's display name using the established name-resolution helper before composing the body, falling back to the raw value only when the user cannot be resolved. Independent of FEAT-002.
steps: Confirm baseline: from mgmt/backend run `node --test --test-reporter=spec test/*.test.mjs` and confirm 1114 pass / 0 fail before making changes.
In mgmt/backend/src/push.js, import userByIdCode from './lookups.js' (top of file alongside the existing imports from './auth.js' and './logger.js').

In notifyNewContribution(env, ctx, payload): after computing the raw code `const code = (payload && (payload.Name ?? '')).toString().trim();`, resolve it to a display name using the same pattern as email.js:141 / whatsapp.js:573: `const contributor = code ? await userByIdCode(env, code) : null;` then choose the display name as `const name = (contributor && (contributor.Name ?? '').toString().trim()) || code;`. This means: if the code resolves to a USERS row, use that row's display Name; otherwise gracefully fall back to the raw value (which may be a blank string, a resell/material detail string, or an unresolved code). Do NOT throw if the lookup fails — the lookup itself is fail-soft, but keep the whole block inside the existing try/catch that already log-and-swallows.

Apply the resolved `name` to BOTH branches of the existing body composition: the money branch (`'Naya contribution mila: ₹' + amount + (name ? ' by ' + name : '')`) AND the no-amount material/service branch (`'Naya contribution mila' + (name ? ': ' + name : '')`). The neutral wording when name is blank must be preserved exactly (a resell/material row where Name is blank still reads 'Naya contribution mila' / 'Naya contribution mila: ₹<amount>').

Keep the log-and-swallow invariant intact: a name-lookup or notification failure must never fail the contribution save. Note the caller in index.js (~line 898) wraps this in ctx.waitUntil(push.notifyNewContribution(env, ctx, req.payload)) for COLLECTIONS adds — do not change the caller.

Add a prove-first test file mgmt/backend/test/push-notification-name.test.mjs following the import/seed pattern in email-collection-resend.test.mjs and h11-m14-batched-lookups.test.mjs. Use makeD1/makeKV/schemaFor from ./helpers/stubs.mjs. Because broadcast() no-ops unless VAPID keys are configured, structure the tests around the composed body. Preferred approach: extract the body-composition + name-resolution into a small exported pure-ish helper (e.g. `export async function composeNewContributionBody(env, payload)`) that notifyNewContribution calls, and assert on it directly. If you extract such a helper, notifyNewContribution must keep behaving identically. Seed a USERS row via `env.DB_CORE.prepare('INSERT INTO users (id_code, name) VALUES (?,?)').bind('USER0001','Ashutosh Chandan').run()` (schemaFor('core.sql')).

Cover these cases in the test: (a) payload {Name:'USER0001', Amount:956} that resolves -> body contains 'by Ashutosh Chandan' and NOT 'by USER0001'; (b) payload {Name:'USER9999', Amount:501} that does NOT resolve -> body falls back to '...by USER9999'; (c) no-amount material row {Name:'USER0001'} (Amount blank/0) -> body reads 'Naya contribution mila: Ashutosh Chandan' (name resolved, no ₹); (d) blank-name/resell row {Name:'', Amount:300} -> neutral 'Naya contribution mila: ₹300' with no ' by '.
acceptance_criteria: notifyNewContribution (or its extracted body-composition helper) produces a body containing the resolved display name 'by Ashutosh Chandan' when payload.Name is an id code 'USER0001' that exists in the users table with name 'Ashutosh Chandan'.
When payload.Name does not resolve to a users row, the body falls back to the raw value (e.g. 'by USER9999').
The no-amount branch appends the resolved name; the blank-name branch keeps the neutral wording with no ' by ' / trailing name.
The contribution-save path never fails on a lookup/notification error (existing try/catch preserved; caller unchanged).
Running `node --test --test-reporter=spec test/*.test.mjs` from mgmt/backend passes with 0 failures and a total >= 1114 (baseline + new tests), including the schema-drift/guard tests.
verification: cd mgmt/backend && node --test --test-reporter=spec test/*.test.mjs — all pass, 0 fail, count >= baseline 1114 plus the new tests.
Read the new test to confirm it asserts on the resolved name and would FAIL if push.js reverted to using the raw payload.Name.
findings: Fixed in mgmt/backend/src/push.js: imported userByIdCode from ./lookups.js and extracted composeNewContributionBody(env, payload) which resolves the raw USER#### code (payload.Name) to the display name via userByIdCode (fail-soft, USERS in env.DB_CORE), falling back to the raw code/blank when unresolved. Applied to both the money branch and the no-amount material/service branch; neutral wording for blank-name preserved. notifyNewContribution now calls the helper and behaves identically; its try/catch log-and-swallow invariant is unchanged; caller in index.js untouched. Added prove-first test/push-notification-name.test.mjs (4 tests): resolve->name, unresolved->raw fallback, no-amount->resolved name w/o rupee, blank-name->neutral wording. Verified prove-first by reverting to raw payload.Name (2 tests fail). Baseline 1114 pass/0 fail confirmed before change; after change full suite = 1118 pass / 0 fail (cd mgmt/backend && node --test --test-reporter=spec test/*.test.mjs). Committed on branch fix/notif-name-and-pwa-shortcut-icons (be2c52d). Did NOT touch Public/frontend-v6 (FEAT-002).
